name: Blackfathom Villainy
summary: At Blackfathom Deeps, Argent Guard Thaelrid calls the Alliance to stop Twilight Lord Kelris. The cult leader sacrifices captives to Aku'mai, and Thaelrid asks you to bring Kelris's severed head to the Argent Dawn in Darnassus as proof.

sections.title: A Defiled Sanctuary
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps was once a night elven temple devoted to Elune. Corruption from an ancient Old God rose through the rock and fouled the Moon Well. From the tainted waters beneath the depths, Aku'mai crawled forth, a voracious servant of that darkness. After the temple was defiled, the Twilight's Hammer joined forces with local naga. Its holy halls became a place of ritual murder.

sections.title: The Fallen Guard's Plea
sections.body: Argent Guard Thaelrid entered Blackfathom Deeps on behalf of his order. There, he was grievously wounded and drained of strength. Surrounded by enemies, he knows he cannot finish his mission alone. So he pleads with brave Alliance travelers who reach him to kill Twilight Lord Kelris. Kelris leads the cultists in sacrificing innocents to Aku'mai for dark power.

sections.title: Justice in Darnassus
sections.body: At the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Kelris's severed head is presented to Dawnwatcher Selgorm. The offering brings a long and troubling hunt to an end. The Argent Dawn feared Kelris was dead or lost to the shadows. Time and again, he had been involved when dark forces stirred in Kalimdor. His death secures a vital victory against the cult's designs in Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Thaelrid is an Argent Dawn operative sent to investigate the growing shadow within Blackfathom Deeps. Grievously wounded in the depths and spent of strength, he calls on passing travelers to stop Kelris.

faq.q: Why is Twilight Lord Kelris being targeted?
faq.answer: Kelris leads the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Blackfathom Deeps. He sacrifices innocent captives to Aku'mai, a foul beast linked to the Old Gods, in exchange for malevolent power.
Dawnwatcher Selgorm is an Argent Dawn representative stationed on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. He oversees the order's efforts against encroaching corruption across northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the history of Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Before Blackfathom Deeps became a sunken lair, its caverns held a great night elven temple devoted to Elune. The temple fell into ruin after an Old God's malice rose up and fouled its sacred Moon Well.

Aku'mai is a monstrous, hydra-like servant of an Old God that crawled from the tainted waters beneath Blackfathom Deeps. The Twilight's Hammer reveres Aku'mai and feeds it captives for dark blessings.

faq.q: Why are the Twilight's Hammer and naga working together?
faq.answer: The reason for the pact between the Twilight's Hammer and the naga is not fully known. In Blackfathom Deeps, they have joined forces to occupy the ruined temple grounds while the cult sacrifices captives to Aku'mai.

angles.text: As a night elf, avenging the defilement of an ancient temple of Elune and cleansing its poisoned Moon Well strikes at the heart of kaldorei heritage.
As an Alliance member, you help the Argent Dawn guard Ashenvale's vulnerable borders against cult infiltration by aiding them against Kelris.
As a paladin, answering the Argent Dawn's call to slay a cultist who sacrifices innocents to primordial horrors is holy retribution.
As a priest, stopping Kelris ends the blasphemous desecration of waters once held holy in devotion to the divine.
